away.name: Mackenzie Blackwood
away.news: Blackwood has had some ups and downs early in the 2026-27 season, but remains Colorado's go-to option, as Scott Wedgewood has been unable to find his footing. In his last three games (3-0-0), Blackwood has a 1.34 GAA and a .952 SV%. The Avalanche enter Wednesday's game as -101 road underdogs against a struggling Utah Mammoth team that has lost six straight games (0-3-3).

home.name: Sebastian Cossa
